core_scenarios.brief: Responsive commerce website for an independent urban bicycle retailer. First-time riders need fit and use-case confidence before buying.

facts: The assortment, prices, test rides, workshop service, and purchase path must be concrete.
pressures: Support confident fit and use-case selection before asking for purchase commitment.

core_scenarios.brief: Municipal online service for residents to check permit eligibility, apply, upload documents, track status, and recover from missing evidence.

facts: A failed or misunderstood application can delay a resident's legal activity.
pressures: Prevent avoidable submission errors and make recovery and status legible without commercial persuasion.

core_scenarios.brief: Pediatric care mobile app for parents to triage symptoms, book appointments, manage medication reminders, and understand when to seek urgent care.

facts: The product cannot replace clinical diagnosis.
pressures: Reduce harmful ambiguity while preserving an immediate escalation path and calm comprehension.

core_scenarios.brief: Independent literary magazine publishing long-form fiction, criticism, themed issues, authors, archives, events, and paid membership.

facts: Sustained reading and issue relationships are primary content behavior.
pressures: Let editorial value and reading continuity precede membership conversion.

core_scenarios.brief: Keyboard-first warehouse operations workspace for dispatchers managing live inventory, exceptions, transfers, receiving, and audit history on desktop.

facts: Dispatchers repeatedly detect, inspect, and resolve time-sensitive exceptions.
pressures: Minimize time and context switching between exception detection, decision, action, and auditability.

core_scenarios.brief: Website and shop for an experimental musician: releases, performances, essays, limited physical editions, listening, and direct fan purchase.

facts: Listening and authorship must remain perceptually primary.
pressures: Support direct purchase without reducing the artist's body of work to a generic product catalog.

preservation.brief: Fix dialog focus restoration in the existing product without redesigning it.

facts: The existing visual and component system is coherent and accepted.
pressures: Correct the focus defect while preserving unrelated accepted decisions.

progressive_disclosure.task: Restore focus after an existing dialog closes without changing its design system.
progressive_disclosure.reason: The product structure and visual language are accepted; only an interaction/accessibility defect is open.

progressive_disclosure.task: Reorganize a municipal permit journey across eligibility, evidence, submission, recovery, and status.
progressive_disclosure.reason: The organizing logic and whole journey are open; visual assets and motion are not yet decisions.

progressive_disclosure.task: Decide whether a dense warehouse exception workspace needs imagery.
progressive_disclosure.reason: The active comparison is image versus no image; generation workflow ends when no image wins.

progressive_disclosure.task: Choose a familiar close glyph from the product's existing icon family.
progressive_disclosure.reason: A known system action in an accepted family does not justify custom drawing or broader art direction.

progressive_disclosure.task: Compare several rendered products for unexplained topology and visual-language repetition.
progressive_disclosure.reason: The active work is cross-scenario evidence, not asset production or local retrieval.

scope_calibration.task: Correct a two-pixel spacing defect in one existing button state while preserving the accepted component contract.

observed.consequence: button label and action alignment remain visually stable
observed.affected_invariant: the accepted button spacing token is applied in the target state

expected.stop_evidence: rendered affected state confirms the invariant
expected.escalation_evidence: new owner, sibling consumer, or material contract uncertainty

scope_calibration.task: Restore focus to the invoking control after one existing dialog closes without changing the product's visual system.

observed.consequence: a keyboard user can continue from the invoking control after dismissal
observed.affected_invariant: dialog close restores focus to the invoking control

expected.stop_evidence: keyboard and rendered focus proof closes the invariant
expected.escalation_evidence: the focus controller is shared by sibling dialogs or the contract remains unknown

scope_calibration.task: A compact notification appears clipped in one card; inspection shows the shared notification primitive and its overflow contract serve several surfaces.

observed.consequence: notifications remain readable and unclipped across consuming surfaces
observed.affected_invariant: the shared notification overflow contract preserves readable content

expected.stop_evidence: baseline/challenger renders preserve the shared contract in representative sibling contexts
expected.escalation_evidence: proof exposes material uncertainty in goals, topology, journey, content, interaction, responsive, or system contracts

scope_calibration.task: Add saved filters to an established warehouse workspace while preserving its accepted objects, route, keyboard model, and responsive transformation.

observed.consequence: dispatchers can recover repeated filter views without losing task context
observed.affected_invariant: saved-filter discovery and persistence preserve the accepted workflow
observed.owner: existing filter bar and persistence adapter

expected.stop_evidence: the affected workflow and responsive proof close the placement/disclosure choice
expected.escalation_evidence: the feature changes the accepted object model, journey, interaction contract, or responsive transformation

scope_calibration.task: Reorganize a municipal permit journey across eligibility, evidence, submission, recovery, and status for residents and assisted-service staff.

observed.consequence: residents can complete and recover a permit submission without avoidable delay
observed.affected_invariant: eligibility, evidence, submission, recovery, and status remain coherent across the journey

delivery: external evidence that changed the outcome, if any
asset and motion decisions when live
expected.stop_evidence: whole-journey proof and implementation contract close the material uncertainties
expected.escalation_evidence: new material uncertainty or failed proof slice reopens the relevant decision

scope_calibration.task: Repair focus-indicator clipping on one accepted medication-dose confirmation control without changing its learned action, content, or workflow.

observed.consequence: a keyboard user can verify the active dose-confirmation control before committing a medication action
observed.affected_invariant: the complete focus indicator remains visible at zoom and high contrast in every confirmation state

expected.stop_evidence: keyboard, zoom, high-contrast, adverse-state, and rollback checks close the exact confirmation-control invariant
expected.escalation_evidence: the repair exposes a shared owner or uncertainty in medication action semantics, recovery, or system contracts
